final: WITH g AS (SELECT pt.TrackId AS TrackId, m.Name AS Name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY pt.TrackId, m.Name), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.Name, SUM(g.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(1.0 * g.cnt / s.total) AS avg_ratio FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY g.Name
